# appsignal_app (Data Source)

Use this data source to look up an existing app, either by ID or by its name and environment combination.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Get app by ID
data "appsignal_app" "by_id" {
  id = "abcdef"
}

# Get app by name and environment
data "appsignal_app" "by_name" {
  name        = "my-app"
  environment = "production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `environment` (String) The environment of the app. Must be specified together with name, and cannot be combined with id.
- `id` (String) The ID of the app. Either this or the combination of name and environment must be specified.
- `name` (String) The name of the app. Must be specified together with environment, and cannot be combined with id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was created.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the app was updated.
